forbiddenClaims: a decorative chart is presented as playable gameplay
hardBlockers: the primary game action cannot be completed at 390 pixels
cases.prompt: Make the market-reactive crypto game genuinely playable with thumb-sized controls, visible market mechanics, truthful data mode, and stable game state at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths.
cases.title: Playable market-reactive crypto game

forbiddenClaims: important market columns are silently hidden without an alternate view
hardBlockers: content overflows horizontally at any required viewport
cases.prompt: Balance dense coin comparison, filters, market metadata, and research links so expert users retain scan speed while tablet and mobile layouts avoid clipped tables or horizontal overflow.
cases.title: Dense market aggregator without overflow

forbiddenClaims: mobile navigation removes access to an application route
hardBlockers: active route state is ambiguous or keyboard-inaccessible

forbiddenClaims: desktop columns are merely scaled down on mobile
hardBlockers: critical alert actions or evidence require horizontal scrolling

cases.title: Mobile-first 390 pixel information hierarchy

forbiddenClaims: tablet is an untested interpolation between desktop and mobile
hardBlockers: primary research content is obscured by fixed chrome

cases.title: Purposeful tablet workspace composition

forbiddenClaims: visual polish removes focus outlines or semantic labels
hardBlockers: critical Axe findings or invisible focus remain

forbiddenClaims: generic dashboard cards are accepted as category specificity
hardBlockers: the primary prediction workflow is not visually discoverable

forbiddenClaims: desktop success is used to waive a mobile visual failure
hardBlockers: release passes while horizontal overflow remains at 390 pixels

forbiddenClaims: parallel agents mutate the canonical project directly
hardBlockers: a partial or overlapping patch becomes canonical

forbiddenClaims: overlapping file scopes execute concurrently
hardBlockers: two concurrent patches target the same canonical file
cases.prompt: Detect two planned agent tasks that both modify the same route module, serialize them through an explicit dependency, and keep unrelated test work parallel.
cases.title: Serialize overlapping agent scopes

forbiddenClaims: a stale patch is force-applied over newer user work
hardBlockers: canonical state contains hunks from an obsolete revision
cases.prompt: When a subagent patch targets an obsolete base revision, reject it without partial apply, refresh only that task context, and rerun against the current canonical revision.

forbiddenClaims: earlier patches remain committed after batch failure
hardBlockers: a failed merge changes the canonical project hash

forbiddenClaims: resume repeats a completed publication or provider action
hardBlockers: cancelled child work mutates the project after cancellation

cases.title: Cancel and resume durable agent run

forbiddenClaims: one verification branch can hide failure in the other
hardBlockers: release verdict occurs before all required evidence joins
cases.prompt: After a stable candidate revision, run browser QA and security artifact checks in parallel, collect independent evidence, and join both before the Verifier decides release.
cases.title: Parallel QA and security verification

cases.deterministicBlocker: the run reports success despite a security hard blocker

hardBlockers: the run reports success despite a security hard blocker
cases.prompt: Propagate a hard security finding from a child task to the independent Verifier, cancel unnecessary downstream work, and preserve the blocking evidence in the final run result.
cases.title: Security agent blocks final verifier

forbiddenClaims: all ready tasks start regardless of resource limits
hardBlockers: active tasks or estimated spend exceed configured ceilings
cases.prompt: Schedule a wide task graph under configured concurrency and estimated-cost ceilings, prioritizing critical-path work and deferring optional agents without starving verification.
cases.title: Respect cost and concurrency caps

hardBlockers: any child task starts from an invalid cyclic plan

hardBlockers: restored project hash differs from the checkpoint snapshot
